## Case Studies

- [Automated ICP scoring engine at webAI](https://amit.so/webai-case-study): In the first six months at webAI, stood up a closed-loop ICP scoring engine. Inbound leads land in HubSpot, Clay runs a layered email-discovery waterfall, Apify adds firmographic context, Claude (inside Clay) cleans up the data and identifies HQ location, and HubSpot workflow rules then score the enriched lead and auto-route it to the right AE.
- [Lead-to-cash transformation at DHI Group](https://amit.so/dhi-case-study): Migrated Salesforce Classic to Lightning while re-engineering the full lead-to-cash process. End-to-end process mapping and process improvement across Sales, Marketing, CS, and Finance. Rebuilt pipeline taxonomy, automated opportunity renewals for consistent revenue recognition, and stood up board-ready dashboards. +25% forecasting accuracy.

Architected an AI-driven outbound engine using Clay, n8n, Instantly, and HeyReach. Built Slack-integrated deal alert workflows and JSON-based AI personalization frameworks.

Designed pipeline and forecasting frameworks from scratch, improving accuracy by 25%. Built automated board-ready dashboards visualizing CAC, LTV, ARR, and funnel metrics.

He now applies that operating instinct to CRM architecture, revenue systems, and cross-functional GTM leadership. He is currently a Fractional GTM Engineer at RevShoppe and is open to RevOps and GTM leadership opportunities.
